name: monthly-expenses-mobile
description: Android, iPhone and web app for Monthly Expenses

scripts.android:init: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug-apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:init: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync ios
